It contains all metadata needed to reconstruct the forensic chain: Evidence → Transcript → MediaAsset. The three segments are stored here and cross-referenced back to their parent Evidence node.

The carrier's explicit statement redirecting the passenger to a written complaint process — with no vouchers, no rebooking, no assistance — is the observable behavior grounding the CBA service failure violation.
